text:
Ravi: Quick decision needed for onboarding surface — compact rail (chips) vs thumbnail shelf on first-run? Leaning compact rail for MVP.
Mina: compact rail +1. Less visual weight and keeps header clean. Thumbnails look great but distract.
Diego: agree with Mina. We can reserve thumbnails for the A/B. Also want to tie samples into checklist completion.
Lina: accessibility: if rail, ensure skip-link, aria-live announce only on first render, and visible focus states on chips. Contrast on any text-over-image must meet AA.
Ravi: dev note: route param approach is simplest: /projects/:id?sample=vector-chat. No onboarding store.
Mina: copy suggestion: header "Try a starter project" sub "Run one in under 5 minutes" CTA on chips = "Run". Actionable.
Diego: analytics: rail_shown, rail_collapsed, sample_started, sample_finished. Mina can own events?
Mina: I'll add events + a small funnel for day1 retention.
design-bot: Reminder: attach Figma handoff + tokens by Friday EOD.
Ravi: timeline: MVP (compact rail + route param + analytics) in next sprint. Thumbnails follow-up for A/B. Lina will add a11y checklist to PR.
Lina: will add checklist and run keyboard/VO pass on PR.
Diego: decision log: ship compact rail for first-run, collapsed chip rail for returners, stateless route param linking, instrument events. Follow-up A/B with thumbnails. Moving to sprint board. :rocket:
